facts.fact: Benbere reports that Mali laid the first stone of the Centre d'intelligence artificielle et de robotique (CIAR-Mali) near Kati in June 2023, at an estimated FCFA 3.3 billion, and that as of May 2025 its buildings were not finished.
Benbere reports that the Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel du Mali (APDP-Mali) signed a partnership convention with CIAR-Mali in February 2025, so the body is acting.
Benbere reports that the data protection authority APDP-Mali signed a partnership convention with CIAR-Mali in February 2025, so the body is acting.

MLI.note: The data protection law itself is not described.
Sovereignty is mentioned only in general terms; nothing on state data or systems.
